RunnerEnvironment.description: What a program ran in: the content address of the image, the OCI runtime and its isolation.

image_id.description: Image id (`sha256:` of the image config), pinned by the host.

interpreter.description: Interpreter version reported by the image during preflight.

oci_runtime.description: OCI runtime name as the container engine reports it (`runsc`, `runc`).

RunnerIsolation.description:
Isolation the runner actually provided. Recorded on every execution and in capability status;
never inferred from configuration alone (the preflight probe proves it).

oneOf.description: OCI container under gVisor (`runsc`): a user-space kernel between the program and the host.

OCI container under the host kernel (namespaces, seccomp, no capabilities). Development
isolation; the public deployment uses `gvisor`.

RuntimeBuildManifest.description:
Identity and configuration of the runtime build that hosts episodes (no secrets), produced by the
runtime preflight.

binary_hash_pinned.description: The binary hash was checked against a configured pin (otherwise only recorded).

binary_sha256.description: Hex sha256 of the runtime binary.

forwarded_env.description: Names (never values) of the environment variables forwarded to the runtime.

protocol_schema_sha256.description: Hex sha256 over the protocol schema bundle generated by this binary.

RuntimeCredentials.description: How the agent runtime authenticates (never the credential itself).

oneOf.description: A key or token forwarded from the host's environment.
A signed-in plan account in a shared login home.
Nothing configured yet: turns fail until a credential is set.

RuntimeKind.description:
Agent runtime hosting an episode (ADR 17): the pinned Codex App Server, or Claude Code in
headless mode. Each owns its own model/tool loop; IGNIS maps, stores and audits both the same way.

RuntimeProfile.description:
Tool and sandbox profile of the agent runtime. Closed: a wider profile (shell, web search) needs
demonstrated isolation first (master design §6.4).

oneOf.description: No shell, no web search, no browser/computer use, read-only sandbox; approvals go to the host.

ServiceStatus.description: Whether a service is configured in this deployment, and why not when it is not.

ToolEffect.description: Side-effect class of a tool. Approval and idempotency policy key on it.

ToolStatus.description: A catalog tool and whether this deployment serves it.

reason.description: Why it is not served; present exactly when `available` is false.

description: `GET /api/v1/capabilities`: what this deployment can serve and why not when it cannot.

mcp.description: The IGNIS MCP endpoint the agent runtime reaches the tools through (loopback only).

runner_environment.description: What programs run in, when the runner passed preflight.

runtime_build.description: Identity of the pinned runtime build when the runtime is available.

tools.description: The tool catalog with what this deployment can actually serve.
